title: Prime Day Is Over, but These Top Deals Are Still Here—for Now
gist: WIRED's post-Prime-Day roundup lists surviving discounts such as MacBook Air M5 at $1,099, AirPods Pro 3 at $179 and Shark PowerDetect UV Reveal at $750. Editors' remarks also note Amazon's Kindle price hikes, Apple price rises, a sold-out Mac Mini and a Bose and Sonos model-refresh clearance.

insights.claim: Amazon's fall sale (Big Deal Days 2026) ran October 6 through midnight October 7, and WIRED's featured picks afterward included MacBook Air M5 at $1,099 ($200 off), AirPods Pro 3 at $179, Kindle Colorsoft at $190, Shark PowerDetect UV Reveal at $750 and De'Longhi Rivelia at $1,000.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Reference points for consumer-electronics promotional pricing in fall 2026.

insights.claim: The MacBook Air M5 at $1,099 was its lowest price since June, and the reviewer notes that laptop prices have gone up considerably over the past year.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Even the discounted price sits above last year's, consistent with broad hardware price inflation.

insights.claim: Amazon raised prices on most Kindle models; the base Kindle that used to dip below $100 at sale events is now $104 on sale, and the Colorsoft base model rose to $290 from $250 at the end of August.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Amazon's e-reader pricing floor has structurally shifted up.

insights.claim: The Mac Mini has been sold out for most of the year due to rapid escalation of interest in using it as a local, agentic AI machine; the new M6 model is faster and more expensive.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Agentic-AI demand is showing up as consumer hardware scarcity.
insights.quote: The Mac Mini has been sold out for the majority of this year due to the rapid escalation of interest in using them as local, agentic AI machines.

insights.claim: The 11-inch iPad on Amazon is described as one of the only iPad deals that survived Apple's price hikes earlier this year.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Apple raised iPad pricing in 2026, limiting promotional room.

insights.claim: Older models were discounted as successors launched: Bose QuietComfort Headphones (1st Gen) at $169 (53% off) as Bose phases them out, Sonos Beam Gen 2 at $359 after the Beam Ultra, and Sony WH-1000XM5 at $198 (about 50% off).
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Prior-generation audio gear is the main source of deep discounts as vendors refresh lineups.
